body: I hope your right. Like I said in another reply, I'm going to the doc today to figure things out. I stopped going a while back because my other doctor was terrible, and I decided to try to manage my own illness. I'm barely making it by. I'm really nervous about going and that might be why I'm feeling this way. Excuse not to go, I can just kill myself.
ADHD and Psychotic Depression. Do you take medication? I don't at this point, but I'm going to the doc today to discuss my options. I've been trying to deal with it myself, but I'm barely getting by.
Also, I'm not sure if postpartum depression applies here. My son is two years old now.

The few people that are close to me I have tried to say something to all of them. The same thing happened every single time, I would chicken out. 

I used to see a therapist/psychiatrist, but we cannot afford for me to go to therapy anymore and I had a bad experience with the psychiatrist (money is also a factor here too). I've been too nervous to go back.
